info.name: Dentex API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Dentex dental-school clinical management backend (Laravel).

Covers Auth, Receptionist, Student (courses, cart, marketplace, appointments, diagnoses, treatments), Instructor (diagnosis review, treatment review), Head of Department (case type / delegation / statistics management), and Store Owner (products, promotions, orders).

Setup:
1. Set `base_url` (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api).
2. Run the relevant Register + Login requests in 'Auth & Profile' for each role, then paste the returned token into the matching *_token collection variable (student_token, instructor_token, receptionist_token, hod_token, store_owner_token).
3. Each folder's Authorization tab is pre-wired to the matching token variable, so every request inside it just works once the variable is set.

request.description: Returns the full store-owner dashboard: order counts by status (pending/processing/ready/completed/rejected + total), financials (total_revenue, average_order_value from completed orders), inventory (low_stock_count, quantity < 5), top_sellers (top 5 best-selling products), and weekly_revenue_chart (last 8 weeks, oldest first). Heavily cached server-side (Redis, tagged per store) — past weeks' revenue is cached indefinitely since it's immutable, only the current week and the other live metrics use short TTLs and are invalidated automatically whenever an order's status changes.

Heavily cached server-side (Redis, tagged per store) — past weeks' revenue is cached indefinitely since it's immutable, only the current week and the other live metrics use short TTLs and are invalidated automatically whenever an order's status changes.

request.description: Dispatches ExportStoreSalesReportJob onto the queue and returns immediately with HTTP 202 (non-blocking) — it does NOT wait for the CSV to be generated. The job queries all completed orders for this store (with items/products/customer eager-loaded) and writes a CSV to storage/app/private/exports/store_{id}/sales_report_{timestamp}.csv. Requires a queue worker to actually be running (php artisan queue:work) since QUEUE_CONNECTION=database in this project — the job will just sit in the jobs table otherwise. No body required.
